subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular installer architecture now, and must `openclaw.ai/install.sh` remain or be generated as one public script?
rationale: The request is maintainability cleanup on a stable setup surface, while docs, tests, release artifacts, and website sync currently assume a single served installer script.

options.title: Approve a guarded split
options.body: Allow modular internal sources only if the public installer remains a generated or preserved single-file artifact with matching website sync and installer smoke proof.

options.title: Permit focused extractions only
options.body: Keep this as backlog guidance and extract installer sections only when tied to concrete bugs, tests, or validation improvements.

options.title: Keep the installer monolithic
options.body: Decide that the served shell installer should stay single-file to minimize helper-loading and packaging risk.

recommendation.title: Approve a guarded split
recommendation.body: Allow modular internal sources only if the public installer remains a generated or preserved single-file artifact with matching website sync and installer smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent installer-specific fixes and shell-helper refactor work make this the strongest available owner signal for the proposed split shape.
